UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_MapImagery_tooltip: Overlay the map with imagery rendered from the actual in-game look (this MOD's core visual). Turn it off to fall back to the vanilla vector style on both the mini-map and world map; icons, resource points, zombie dots and every other feature keep working.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_Players_tooltip: Show your own position marker on the mini-map.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_RemotePlayers_tool: Show other players and their names on the mini-map. Multiplayer only.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_ZombieIntensity_to: Overlay the zombie population heatmap on the mini-map. This shows population density, not live zombie positions; in multiplayer the client may not have this data.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_PlaceNames_tooltip: Show town and area names on the mini-map. Enabling this also turns on "Symbols" in the mini-map gear panel (name rendering is gated by the symbols layer).
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_ZombieDots_tooltip: Draw orange dots on the mini-map for real-time zombie positions (orange to stand apart from the red player marker). Only zombies within the mini-map view are shown (adjustable limit, 200 by default; zombies nearest to you are prioritized when over the limit; sampled every 0.3s). Performance cost grows with the dot limit setting and nearby zombie count; off = zero cost.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_Safehouses_tooltip: Outline every safehouse area on the mini-map: green for safehouses you belong to (owner or invited member), red for other players'. Helps you spot restricted areas. Only drawn when safehouses exist (mainly multiplayer).
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_StreetNames_toolti: Draw street names along roads on the mini-map. The vanilla mini-map never loads street data (only the world map does); this mod loads it, so street-name translation mods apply as well.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_NavRoute_tooltip: After setting a navigation target (right-click), a road-following route is computed and drawn on the mini-map and world map beneath the target flag. Uses the official street data of loaded maps; falls back to the straight-line indicator where no road data exists.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_BtnSearch: Search map: coordinates, street name or facility type
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_SearchHint: Enter a street/facility name or coordinates (x,y or x,y,z)
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_ZDotColor_Red: Red (same as player marker, not recommended)
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_AnimalWild_tooltip: Draw icons on the mini-map for nearby wild animals (deer, rabbits, raccoons, rodents...). Green tint / green corner mark = wild. Sampled every 0.5s; only loaded animals within the mini-map view are shown.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_AnimalLivestock_to: Draw mini-map icons for nearby livestock (cows, sheep, pigs, chickens, etc.). The server may restrict visibility by the safehouse the animal is currently inside, or disable livestock icons entirely. This is a display rule, not animal ownership.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_VehicleDots_toolti: Draw a steering-wheel icon on the mini-map for vehicles within view (the game has no built-in car-shaped map glyph; the steering wheel is the closest vanilla symbol, tinted cyan). Sampled every 0.5s.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_WM_tooltip: Show on the world map (M). Style, colors and filters are shared with the mini-map settings. Only loaded entities near players are drawn, so zooming out never floods the map.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_WMShared: Style, colors and filters follow the mini-map settings
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_LivestockHiddenByS: Livestock visibility is set to "Hide all"
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_AnimalSpeciesFilte: Written automatically by the species checkboxes in the mini-map settings window (CSV of hidden species; empty = show all). Normally no need to edit by hand.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_VehicleCategoryFil: Written automatically by the vehicle category checkboxes in the mini-map settings window (CSV of hidden categories; empty = show all).
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_LockPosition_toolt: When locked, the mini-map cannot be moved by dragging the title bar nor resized by dragging its edges. Prevents accidental drags.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_FloatIcon_tooltip: A small always-on-screen icon that toggles the mini-map on click (no hotkey needed). Hold and drag to reposition; the position is remembered.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_WarnLegacyRender: ⚠ Legacy render path active (low FPS) — press HOME to restore
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_WarnHomeBind: ⚠ HOME clashes with a -debug engine key (FPS drop) — please rebind
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_FloatIconPos_toolt: Written automatically when you drag the floating icon (e.g. 1880,380). Clear this field to restore the default position.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_TextAnnotations_to: The vanilla mini-map uses a compact symbols mode that never draws text annotations such as place names. Enable to use the full symbols mode: text annotations can render (place names still require "Show place names" and "Symbols" in the gear panel), and player-drawn map symbols render at full size, which may look large up close.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_ClickOpenWorldMap: Click mini-map to open world map
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_ClickOpenWorldMap_: Vanilla behavior: a click (without dragging) on the mini-map opens the world map. Off by default; the M key and the M button on the button bar still work.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_FreeLook_tooltip: After dragging, the mini-map stays where you panned; click the mini-map to snap back to your player. Disable for vanilla behavior (snaps back on release).
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_ShowPlayerCoords_t: Show your current x, y, z at the bottom center of the mini-map and the world map (M). The XY button and the right-click menu can copy coordinates regardless of this setting.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_GhostMode_tooltip: Clicks, scroll wheel and right-clicks pass through the mini-map to the game world, and the map body and frame turn semi-transparent — enlarge the map as a permanent overlay without blocking play. Amber border while active. Toggle: this option, the hotkey (default '), or right-click the floating icon. In split-screen this affects all players.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_ResetSize_tooltip: Clear the custom width/height written by edge-drag resizing and return to the square shape of the size preset above.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_CustomSize_tooltip: Written automatically when you drag the mini-map edges to resize (e.g. 300x240). Takes priority over the size preset above. Clear this field, or change the size preset, to reset.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_MapBounds_tooltip: Outline the area of each enabled map MOD on the mini-map and world map (in the chosen color), with its name at the center. Makes MOD maps easy to locate.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_MapPackLayers_tool: Mount and display the MOD map images provided by a map pack. When off, only the base map image remains (outlines are unaffected). The mini-map rebuilds immediately; the world map applies on next load.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_ZoneLayer_tooltip: Highlight custom zones supplied by a zone-layer add-on (such as server regions) with a translucent fill, border and name on both the minimap and the world map. Affects only custom zones, not resource points; turn off to hide these custom zones. This is the master gate for every zone add-on; if an add-on ships its own toggle, both must be on for its zones to show. On servers with many zones, use the "Custom zone display distance" slider to show only nearby zones.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_ZoneNamesFar_toolt: Checked (default): custom zone names show at any zoom level, so zones are easy to locate from afar. Unchecked: small zones show their names only when zoomed in (matching POI behavior). Affects custom zones only, not resource points.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_ZoneCategoryFilter: Comma-separated zone categories to hide (the category checkboxes in the unified settings window write this automatically; empty = show all). Categories come from the "category" field in the server's zones.json.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_ZoneNoCats: No categorized zones yet (servers can add a "category" field to zones in zones.json)
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_PoiIcons_tooltip: Mark vanilla map resource points (military, police, gun store and 20 categories in total) with icons on both the minimap and world map. On by default; toggle individual categories under "Resource categories" below.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_PoiBlocks_tooltip: Additionally outline resource point areas with a translucent block and name (off by default). Independent from icons; both can be on at once.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_PoiColorIcons_tool: Draw resource point icons in full color. Checked: full-color icons. Unchecked (default): a monochrome silhouette tinted by the category color. Affects icons only.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_PoiWholeBuilding_t: Checked (default): the whole building is drawn as one block. Unchecked: only the category's own rooms. Requires "Show resource blocks"; icon placement and display distance are both unaffected. On large buildings (malls) the whole-building area can be far larger than the actual shop area.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_SecDistanceEsc: Display distance (0 = no limit; also capped by the server)
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_DistNote: Value = your setting / server cap; the lower one applies. 0 = no limit
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_PerfIntro: The more icons and blocks shown, the higher the cost (roughly proportional to the on-screen count; off = zero cost). Measured anchor: this mod plus the always-on minimap at default settings costs about 0.6ms per frame, about 4 percent of a 60fps frame budget.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_PerfDescMap: Engine-native layer rendering, no per-frame Lua cost
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_PerfDescPoi: About 1700 entries fully enabled are included in the measured anchor (viewport candidate cache)
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_PerfDescZone: Grows with how many zones the server defines; tighten with the custom zone display distance
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_PerfDescZombie: Grows with the dot cap (100-800) and nearby zombie count; off by default
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_PerfDescAnimal: Sampled every 0.5s, capped at 100 in view; off by default
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_PerfNoteWorldmap: The world map (M) adds more overlay cost than the corner minimap while open; closing it reclaims the cost.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_PerfAdvice: If it feels laggy: turn off zombie dots or lower their cap first, then shrink display distances and disable unused layers and categories.
